gumtree_entries.description:
ADDED i2: Behavioural tests for {@link CircularByteBuffer}.

The class under test is a fixed-capacity ring buffer of bytes. Bytes are appended with {@code add(...)} and
ADDED i3: Capacity used by the no-argument constructor (IOUtils.DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE).
ADDED i4: Fully-qualified name used by EvoSuite to verify the origin of thrown exceptions.
ADDED i18: drains the first byte
ADDED i21: empties the buffer again
ADDED i22: buffer now holds 4 bytes
ADDED i28: Buffer is empty, so any length-prefixed comparison trivially holds.
